title: Encrypted Envelope
description: Versioned framing for one encrypted object. Contains only safe framing data: the object is authenticated with immutable context (vaultID, objectID, objectType, schemaVersion, encryptionSuiteVersion) as AES-GCM associated data, which is NOT repeated in the envelope to avoid substitution. Remote filenames are random/opaque and do NOT encode objectType. Schema version 1.

objectId.description: Opaque object identifier (random). Not necessarily the semantic entity UUID; must not reveal object type.

nonce.description: Base64 cryptographically-secure random nonce for AES-GCM.

ciphertext.description: Base64 AES-GCM ciphertext (combined with authentication tag where the implementation uses combined mode).

tag.description: Base64 authentication tag when not included in combined ciphertext; null otherwise.

$comment: Authenticated associated data (AAD) = canonical bytes of {vaultId, objectId, objectType, schemaVersion, encryptionSuiteVersion}. Mismatch of any AAD field MUST fail closed. Exhaustive fail-closed input list (FR-160d, clarified 2026-08-07): (a) wrong password; (b) modified ciphertext; (c) invalid/mismatched auth tag; (d) mismatched object ID; (e) mismatched object type; (f) mismatched vault ID; (g) unsupported envelope schema version; (h) corrupted/truncated envelope structure. Each input MUST be covered by a deterministic test vector. For every input, the application MUST reject the object without writing local data, accepting the remote object, or overwriting a local version. The list is exhaustive for the initial release; any newly introduced envelope field or context dimension MUST add a corresponding fail-closed input and test vector. Wrong-password retry policy (FR-160e, clarified 2026-08-07): wrong-password unlock attempts MUST NOT be rate-limited, throttled, or lockout-bounded by the application; every wrong-password attempt fails closed without caching the supplied password or derived key, and brute-force resistance relies entirely on the Argon2id production minimums (FR-160c).
